verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents selecting a specific process guide version by integer, and its skill files are written into the project and can be committed for the team. That gives a lead some control over when changes land. Pinning the CLI release (ultrametric@0.4.1) relies on npm's own version pinning, so it is not counted as the product's capability. Missing for 10: a lockfile or manifest that pins skill/process versions, documented update and notification behaviour for hosted processes, a way to pin team-wide, and hands-on corroboration that pinned versions stay stable.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates

citations.quote: To select a specific version, replace `VERSION` with its positive integer version number
You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.
The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.
